units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2) repeated administrative offences (two or more times within a year) for which the law provides the penalty of administrative detention, where the person’s commission of those offences has been established through judicial proceedings;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3) failure to comply with the time limit for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through direct expression of the population’s will.
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Paragraph deleted by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.10.2011 No. 67/47.
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 15 · “Paragraph deleted by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. The Head of Yekaterinburg is recalled by voting at polling stations.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. Lists of polling districts specifying their boundaries and the addresses and telephone numbers of precinct election commissions are published by the Head of Yekaterinburg in the mass media no later than 25 days before polling day.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. The initiative to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg belongs to persons entitled to participate in municipal elections who constitute at least five percent of the municipality’s registered voters.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. Any voter or group of voters entitled to participate in a recall vote may form a recall initiative group of at least 100 persons.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6. The decision to establish an initiative group, its number of members and its individual membership is adopted by participants in a meeting of a group of citizens in accordance with the procedure provided for by a decision of that meeting.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Notice of the meeting is sent to the City Duma and to the person against whom a recall vote initiative may be launched no later than 5 days before the meeting.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 15 · “Notice of the meeting is sent to the City Duma and to the…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Before the meeting, participants are registered in writing, stating their surnames, given names, patronymics, dates of birth, residential addresses, and the series and numbers of their passports or documents replacing a citizen’s passport. Registration is confirmed by each participant’s personal signature.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 15 · “Before the meeting, participants are registered in writing,…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: The meeting must have at least 200 participants. Minutes are drawn up recording the decision adopted. The minutes state the date and place of the meeting, the number of participants, the substance of the matter considered, the voting results and decisions adopted, and the list of initiative group members with each member’s surname, given name, patronymic, date of birth, residential address, and the series and number of their passport or other identity document. The minutes are signed by the chair and secretary of the meeting. A list of meeting participants is attached to the minutes. The initiative group elects its own chair independently.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 15 · “The meeting must have at least 200 participants. Minutes are…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Documents for registration of the initiative group are submitted no later than seven days after the meeting.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 15 · “Documents for registration of the initiative group are…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 7. The City Duma registers the initiative group to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg no later than 15 days after receiving the meeting minutes and the documents attached to them.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Registration of the initiative group may be refused only where the meeting procedure or deadlines for submitting registration documents established by this Charter have been breached.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 15 · “Registration of the initiative group may be refused only where…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 8. Upon registering the initiative group, the City Duma issues its chair a registration certificate and permission to open a special temporary account for the initiative group’s support fund.
units.label: Point 8 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: The forms of the initiative group registration certificate and permission to open a special temporary account for its support fund are approved by the City Duma. The initiative group registration certificate is valid for one month from its date of issue.
units.label: Point 8 Art. 15 · “The forms of the initiative group registration certificate and…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 9. At the initiative group’s request, the Head of Yekaterinburg provides information on registered voters in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the electoral rights of citizens of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 9 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 10. Receipt of the initiative group registration certificate constitutes the basis for beginning collection of signatures in support of the proposal to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg. The initiative group bears the costs of collecting signatures.
units.label: Point 10 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Signatures are collected by completing signature sheets containing the proposal to hold a recall vote.
units.label: Point 10 Art. 15 · “Signatures are collected by completing signature sheets…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 11. A citizen supporting the initiative to hold a recall vote personally enters their signature and the date of signing on the signature sheet, stating their surname, given name, patronymic, date of birth, residential address, and the series and number of their passport or document replacing a citizen’s passport.
units.label: Point 11 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 12. A signature sheet supporting the proposal to hold a recall vote states:
units.label: Point 12 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1) the name of the municipality in which signatures are being collected;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 12 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2) the initiative group’s registration date and registration certificate number;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 12 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3) the proposal to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg, stating the Head’s surname, given name and patronymic;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 12 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4) the citizen’s surname, given name, patronymic, date of birth and residential address, and the series and number of their passport or document replacing a passport.
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 12 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Each signature sheet must be certified by the signatures of the person who collected citizens’ signatures and one initiative group member, stating the certification date and each of those persons’ surname, given name, patronymic, date of birth, residential address, and the series and number of their passport or document replacing a citizen’s passport.
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 12 Art. 15 · “Each signature sheet must be certified by the signatures of the…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 13. After signature collection ends, but no later than expiry of the initiative group registration certificate, the initiative group counts the total number of signatures and draws up a final record. The maximum number of signatures submitted may not exceed the number established by point 4 of this Article by more than five percent.
units.label: Point 13 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: The numbered and bound signature sheets and the original final record are delivered by representatives of the initiative group to the City Duma. Signature sheets completed in breach of the requirements of this Charter are not accepted.
units.label: Point 13 Art. 15 · “The numbered and bound signature sheets and the original final…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 14. Within ten days, the City Duma organizes verification of compliance with this Charter’s requirements in collecting signatures supporting a recall vote. Representatives of the initiative group may be present during verification of the signature sheets.
units.label: Point 14 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: The second paragraph was repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76.
units.label: Point 14 Art. 15 · “The second paragraph was repealed with effect from 31 October…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 15. If this Charter’s requirements have not been observed in collecting signatures supporting a recall vote, the City Duma adopts a decision refusing to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg. That decision must be published (promulgated).
units.label: Point 15 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 16. If the City Duma adopts a decision to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg, the Head of Yekaterinburg, no later than 15 days after publication (promulgation) of that decision, submits a proposal to the City Duma to allocate municipal budget funds for organizing and holding the recall vote.
units.label: Point 16 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 17. Precinct commissions for a recall vote are formed in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the electoral rights of citizens of the Russian Federation and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast adopted in accordance with it.
units.label: Point 17 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 18. Repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76.
units.label: Point 18 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 19. The Head of Yekaterinburg against whom recall proceedings have been initiated may participate in campaigning during the recall on the same terms as other citizens and give explanations concerning the circumstances put forward as grounds for recall, including during the meeting to establish the initiative group.
units.label: Point 19 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 20. Campaigning during the recall of the Head of Yekaterinburg is conducted:
units.label: Point 20 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1) on television and radio broadcasters’ channels and in periodical print publications;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 20 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2) through mass events (assemblies and meetings with citizens, rallies, demonstrations, marches, public debates and discussions);
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 20 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3) through the production and distribution of printed, audiovisual and other campaign materials;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 20 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4) by other methods not prohibited by law.
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 20 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: The campaign period begins on the day of official publication (promulgation) of the City Duma’s decision to hold a vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg and ends at midnight local time at the beginning of the day before polling day. Campaigning is prohibited on polling day and the preceding day.
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 20 Art. 15 · “The campaign period begins on the day of official publication…”

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 21. Voting, counting of votes and determination of voting totals are carried out in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the electoral rights of citizens of the Russian Federation and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast adopted in accordance with it.
units.label: Point 21 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 22. Repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76.
units.label: Point 22 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 23. The Head of Yekaterinburg is deemed recalled if at least half of all voters registered in the municipality have voted for recall.
units.label: Point 23 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 24. The voting totals for recall of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the decision adopted are subject to official publication (promulgation) within 5 days from adoption of that decision.
units.label: Point 24 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 25. Repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76.
units.label: Point 25 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. Voting is held to obtain the population’s consent to a change in the municipality’s boundaries or transformation of the municipality, except in cases provided for by the federal law establishing the general principles of the organization of local self-government in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. Voting on those matters may be held throughout or in part of the municipality’s territory in accordance with federal law.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. Voting on changing the municipality’s boundaries or transforming the municipality is called by the City Duma and held in accordance with the procedure established for local referendums by federal law and a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 4. Voting on those matters is deemed to have taken place if more than half of the residents of the municipality (the relevant part of its territory) who have voting rights participate. The population’s consent to changing the boundaries or transforming the municipality is deemed obtained if more than half of the residents of the municipality (the relevant part of its territory) who participated in the vote have voted in favour.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 5. The voting totals on changing the municipality’s boundaries or transforming the municipality and the decision adopted are subject to official publication (promulgation).
units.label: Point 5 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 16-1. Citizens’ assembly
units.label: Point 5 Art. 16 · “Article 16-1. Citizens’ assembly”

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. In cases provided for by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’, a citizens’ assembly may be held in settlements within the municipality (or, in accordance with a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast, in part of a settlement’s territory within the municipality).
units.label: Point 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. A citizens’ assembly has a quorum if more than half of the residents of the settlement (or part of its territory) who have voting rights participate. A decision of the assembly is deemed adopted if more than half of its participants have voted in favour.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Voting on changing the boundaries or transforming the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. The procedure for organizing and holding a citizens’ assembly is determined by a decision of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.text: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.label: Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.text: 1. A law-making initiative means citizens’ official submission to the municipality’s local self-government bodies of draft municipal legal acts on matters of local significance.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.text: 2. An initiative group of citizens with voting rights may put forward a law-making initiative in accordance with the procedure established by a decision of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.text: The minimum size of a citizens’ initiative group is established by a decision of the City Duma and may not exceed 3 percent of the municipality’s residents with voting rights.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 17 · “The minimum size of a citizens’ initiative group is established…”

units.locator: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.text: 3. A draft municipal legal act submitted through a citizens’ law-making initiative must be considered by the Head of Yekaterinburg or the City Duma, within whose competence adoption of the act falls, within three months of its submission. If adoption of the submitted draft falls within the City Duma’s competence, it is considered at an open meeting of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.text: Representatives of the citizens’ initiative group must be given an opportunity to present their position during consideration of the submitted draft municipal legal act.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 17 · “Representatives of the citizens’ initiative group must be given…”

units.locator: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.text: 4. The reasoned decision adopted following consideration of a draft municipal legal act submitted through a citizens’ law-making initiative must be officially communicated in writing to the citizens’ initiative group that submitted it.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Citizens’ law-making initiative
units.text: Article 17-1. Initiative projects
units.label: Point 4 Art. 17 · “Article 17-1. Initiative projects”
